claims.claim: Business details are needed to register for VAT.
claims.quote: The information you’ll need to register for VAT depends on the type of your business. Register a limited company You’ll need: your company registration number your business’s bank account details your Unique Taxpayer Reference ( UTR )
claims.note: The page lists business information required for VAT registration.

claims.claim: Turnover evidence is needed to register for VAT.
claims.quote: details of your annual turnover an estimate of your taxable turnover for the next 12 months
claims.note: The page requires turnover details and an estimate, but does not say applicants must supply supporting evidence for them.

claims.claim: A bank account for repayments is needed to register for VAT.
claims.note: The page requires bank account details at registration but does not say the account is specifically for repayments.
